Piano sound: Salamander Grand Piano V3
Yamaha C5, recorded at 48 kHz / 24 bit, 16 velocity layers sampled in minor thirds, plus key-release noises.
Author: Alexander Holm. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
Files used: the FLAC remap at https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano (by kinwie).
In this app the samples are mapped into a Harmonix Fusion patch (tools/salamander_manifest.py,
PianoPatchBuilder commandlet); no audio was changed apart from compression when the game is packaged.
